purpose: Reader-facing source list for the review table on the Spec & policy audit page. One row per official page that the site's claims were checked against, with the section read, the date printed on the page, and what the reading changed on the site.
rule: A blank quote means the page was read but nothing was copied from it. Restricted means the page could not be read and therefore establishes nothing.
